name: Wilson's Fourteen Points
summary: WWI: President Woodrow Wilson outlines principles for peace, including self-determination and a League of Nations.

name: Treaty of Brest-Litovsk
summary: WWI: Bolshevik Russia signs a harsh peace with the Central Powers, leaving the war and surrendering vast territories.

name: Operation Michael
summary: WWI: Germany launches its Spring Offensive, using stormtrooper tactics to break through before American strength becomes decisive.

name: Second Battle of the Marne
summary: WWI: The final German offensive is stopped on the Marne, and Allied counterattacks begin pushing Germany back.

name: Battle of Amiens
summary: WWI: Allied forces launch a surprise combined-arms attack. Ludendorff calls it the black day of the German Army.

name: Hundred Days Offensive
summary: WWI: Allied armies repeatedly break German positions, forcing a sustained retreat across the Western Front.

name: Armistice of Salonica
summary: WWI: Bulgaria signs an armistice after Allied advances in the Balkans, beginning the collapse of the Central Powers.

name: Armistice of Mudros
summary: WWI: The Ottoman Empire signs the Armistice of Mudros, ending its war against the Allies.

name: German Revolution
summary: WWI: Mutiny, strikes, and political revolt bring down the German monarchy as military defeat becomes unavoidable.

name: Armistice of 11 November 1918
summary: WWI: Germany signs the armistice at Compiegne, ending fighting on the Western Front after more than four years of war.
